modelOverview: Introduced in 2013, the Tank MC ("Manufacture Cartier") is a larger, more masculine reinterpretation of the classic Tank silhouette, built around Cartier's in-house automatic Calibre 1904-PS MC. Its three-body brushed steel case, faceted blue-spinel crown and guilloché dial give it a more overtly sporty, contemporary presence than the dressier Tank Louis Cartier or Tank Française.

WSTA0010.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1904-PS MC · 27 jewels · 28,800 vph · ~48h power reserve
WSTA0010.materials: Stainless steel case on an alligator leather strap with steel folding clasp
WSTA0010.dial: Blue sunburst guilloché dial with Roman numerals, railway minute track, blued sword-shaped hands, date aperture at 3 o'clock and small seconds subdial at 6 o'clock
WSTA0010.description: The Tank MC in steel is Cartier's manufacture-movement take on the marque's most recognisable case shape, distinguished by its elongated 34.3mm x 44mm three-body steel case, faceted blue-spinel-set crown and striking blue guilloché dial with railway track and sword hands. It is powered by the in-house automatic Calibre 1904-PS MC, visible through a sapphire exhibition caseback. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
